rootCause.reproduction: The regression test fails before the fix with an immediate redirect decision of null for a domain present only in the managed snapshot.
rootCause.existingTestGap: The previous test asserted the matched policy kind without dispatching a browser redirect.
rootCause.fix: Immediate navigation, routine enforcement, and durable redirect recovery now explicitly consume adultBlocklist matches. Block records retain matched-domain/source evidence.
rootCause.limits: This proves a native Mac enforcement defect. Phone Safari receives a bounded supervised/static domain overlay; exact causes for every historical browser/phone occurrence cannot be reconstructed from the available records.
rootCause.packagedRepairFailure: The packaged script runner chose app.asar/dist as cwd. ASAR is a file, so the Repair network block action failed with spawn ENOTDIR. It now uses the real Resources directory outside the archive.
